description.value: The Liquor Co. 1977 is a cooperative liquor retailer grown out of the Peninsula Co-op, which was founded in 1977 by Saanich Peninsula residents committed to community and cooperative values. Operating multiple Vancouver Island locations, the Esquimalt outlet is situated in Esquimalt Plaza and carries beer, wine, and spirits with an emphasis on local and Canadian products. As a co-op, members receive rebates and exclusive offers, distinguishing it from a typical chain liquor store.
